bridgeRouteRisk.summary: EUROT has independently mintable, immutable StableCoin deployments on Ethereum, Avalanche, and Polygon, which remain native issuance routes in Mint Authority. Each deployment also exposes the issuer-controlled ExternallyTransferable externalTransfer burn and externalTransferFrom arbitrary-mint rail. No primary source identifies the live networkURI mappings, counterpart contracts, peers, validators, escrow, replay protection, conservation check, or rate limits, so Bridge Risk conservatively uses the opaque-or-unknown tier and records the local controller failure domains without treating the rail as a verified supply-conserving bridge.

protocols.name: Token Teknoloji ExternallyTransferable externalTransfer/externalTransferFrom
protocols.note: The verified StableCoin source exposes a user-allowance burn path and a supply-manager arbitrary-mint path, but does not identify the live external route protocol.

routes.reviewNote: At Avalanche block 92986796 on 2026-08-16, the immutable (non-proxy) StableCoin deployment had owner() and supplyManager() equal to EOA 0xff80b391b286887d446b1124820f87d5b049b4fb and direct uncapped mint(uint256) remained available. This route is native issuance and remains in Mint Authority; the same contract's generic ExternallyTransferable rail is assessed separately by the route-scoped bridge control because no live destination or conservation mapping is verified.

At Polygon block 92148079 on 2026-08-16, the immutable (non-proxy) StableCoin deployment had owner() and supplyManager() equal to EOA 0xd61c0129f6c35a675db6e2a067b31e75b2573077, with EOA 0xff80b391b286887d446b1124820f87d5b049b4fb as proposedOwner and able to claim immediately. Direct uncapped mint(uint256) remains native issuance in Mint Authority; the same contract's generic ExternallyTransferable rail is assessed separately by route-scoped bridge controls because no live destination or conservation mapping is verified.

At Ethereum block 25771272 on 2026-08-16, the immutable (non-proxy) StableCoin deployment had owner() and supplyManager() equal to EOA 0xff80b391b286887d446b1124820f87d5b049b4fb, proposedOwner() zero, and direct uncapped mint(uint256) available. This route is native issuance and is added to Mint Authority; the same contract's generic ExternallyTransferable rail is assessed separately by the route-scoped bridge control because no live destination or conservation mapping is verified.

controls.label: EUROT Avalanche external-transfer owner and supply manager

routeChecks.lockboxOrEscrow: No bridge escrow or lockbox is present in the verified StableCoin source; externalTransfer burns from the user after allowance and externalTransferFrom mints through the supply manager before recipient transfer.
routeChecks.trustedPeerOrRemote: externalTransfer and externalTransferFrom accept arbitrary networkURI strings and externalAddress bytes; no on-chain peer or source-chain allowlist is verified.
routeChecks.attestorQuorum: No validator, DVN, signer set, or attestor quorum is present in the verified StableCoin source.
routeChecks.rateLimits: No aggregate, per-call, or route-level rate limit is present in the verified external-transfer path.
routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: The chain-local owner or supply manager controls external transfers and can pause or unpause the token; owner can replace supplyManager. The StableCoin deployment is immutable, so no bridge upgrade admin is present.
routeChecks.onchainAmountBounds: externalTransfer burns only after a user-approved external allowance and balance check; externalTransferFrom mints an arbitrary amount to the supply manager without verified source-burn, lock, or conservation accounting.
routeChecks.unsupportedReason: The exact live external-transfer protocol, networkURI values, destination mapping, and route accounting are unresolved; no replay or conservation protection is verified.

controls.evidence: At Avalanche block 92986796 on 2026-08-16, owner() and supplyManager() both returned 0xff80b391b286887d446b1124820f87d5b049b4fb, an EOA. The verified StableCoin source exposes owner-or-supply-manager externalTransfer burn and externalTransferFrom arbitrary-mint calls accepting arbitrary networkURI and bytes addresses, with no verified peer registry, validator/DVN set, escrow, replay protection, conservation check, or rate limit. The same controller can pause or unpause the token and replace supplyManager; the bridge failure domain is this chain-local EOA and immutable contract.
